scope: setting-1 dense 2D F, monotone axial loading, one unchanged configuration per pair
response: bottom_pressure_E * 10 MPa (bottom force divided by the same plate width)
support: closed [0, min(coarse_terminal_u, fine_terminal_u)] after validating both terminal receipts
samples: sorted union of all native displacements on the support, including both endpoints
interpolation: piecewise linear on each curve; no extrapolation, filtering, or decimation
numerator: maximum absolute coarse-minus-fine response over samples
denominator: maximum absolute fine response over the same samples and support
comparison: 20 * numerator <= denominator on unrounded quantities; equality meets the limit
zero_reference: HOLD, normalized error undefined, including when both curves are identically zero
invalid_input: HOLD for that pair; keep any valid exceedance of the other pair visible
combination: any valid pair above limit is an exceedance; otherwise any required pair without a verdict is HOLD; all required pairs must meet the limit
existing_return: exposed before this rule; retrospective development check only
